body:
MAINLINE-032 checked independently. All 236 numerical/display/source-constant comparisons pass, including all 155 engineering/Boolean RESULTS scalar leaves. Owner timing is metadata. Artifact pins match; no owner code was read or run.

CR-1457 Eq. 2.2-12 and Kdelta reproduce. Fc is the lowest flatwise core compression, core tension and core-facing bond strength. Stabilized compression supplies a conditional candidate, not automatically Fc. Hexcel confirms 60 psi typical, 35 psi minimum average and 15 ksi typical modulus. Typical crush 35 psi is a separate property. Bond/tension values remain missing.

Lead amplitudes at Fc=60 psi reproduce: S-200F/Q0.371, 0.152868766846361 mm; SR-200/Q0.609, 0.0652229064039409 mm. At 35 psi: 0.0891734473270440 and 0.0380466954022988 mm.

The wrinkling cubic gives b=0.6823278038280193; applying it to the waviness-adjusted uniaxial capacity does not count waviness twice. Intracell dimpling uses its separate 0.5 interaction factor, reproducing 9.0188536848 and 4.9753091211.

Correct the CARD's lead-only amplitude/cell range to 0.00684754923–0.01604921437. Its printed 0.0046–0.024 spans all four typical-strength cases. The underlying rows are correct.

Ten nonblocking findings cover this correction, minimum-average interpretation, rounded targets, strength/thickness data, plasticity, wavelengths, metrology and shell transfer. The author correction is verified; SAE class values remain unread. CHECK contains exact deltas, primary-source audit and reconstructed curve artifacts. QUESTIONABLE remains. No successor job.
